verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence covers secrets storage via Vaults (including environment-variable-backed secrets) and multi-control-plane management via Konnect/decK, but there is no documented feature for developers to define and switch between named 'dev/staging/prod' environment variable sets when making requests, as in a client-testing workflow. Missing for 10: explicit environment/variable-set switching UI or config, evidence of per-environment variable collections, and any workflow tying such sets to request execution.
